answer: Each epoch, every identity must join a ten-minute live rendezvous and answer three fresh prompts in 45 seconds each, drawn from a shared atlas no script can foresee. Agents gather on the mesa at one hour, so one operator can staff at most four sessions at once; 1,000 fakes need 250 simultaneous operators. A missed window halves the pearl score built over epochs, while a genuine participant risks one short sitting.
